title: Document a material decision from verified source evidence
prompt: A project changes its authentication architecture. Update the authoritative architecture documentation and create a decision record that separates verified implementation, accepted decision, alternatives, consequences, and remaining unknowns. Do not describe planned behavior as shipped.
preconditions: The repository contains a current implementation diff and an explicit accepted architecture decision.
expected_behaviors: Identify the authoritative document and intended reader before editing.
Verify behavior against source, tests, schemas, and explicit decision evidence.
Record context, decision, alternatives, consequences, status, and date/revision.
Separate shipped behavior from planned or unverified behavior.
Report changed paths and exact evidence references.
must_not: Do not infer approval from discussion or record an assumption as a shipped fact.
Do not silently delete superseded decisions or duplicate large source files.
expected_artifacts: Updated authoritative architecture document and a traceable decision record.
